text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... This test covers way too much ground.
And I really need to ramp up my training for the race, too...
choice_data_list: Balancing academics and racing is tough, isn't it?
Balancing academics and racing is really tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Must be nice for you...
You have less to do while I'm studying for my tests.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really. I braced myself the moment I came
to Tracen Academy, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should give up on trying to cram in extra training during exam week.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should give up on trying to cram in extra training during exam week.

Hold it right there!
Hey, you, prickly girl!

Wait right there!
You cool girl over there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That choice is a non-non!
Are you planning to turn the world gray with your own hands!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Letting the world sway you into giving up on what you want to do... You gotta bite back against unfair crap like that!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the world!
Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You should just do whatever you wanna do!
Just toss tests and stuff right out the window!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Naive, Windy! A true world-class Umamusume needs to be greedy enough to achieve both!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...No, but still,
I just don't have that kind of time—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's simple♪ If we're short on time,
we just have to make our training that much more intense...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Forget cramped, conventional training.
Let's be bolder and far more efficient!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, special training!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Special training? Doing what...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The gentleman beside me can tell you all about that♪
Come on, Trainer! What should she efficiently train
in order to catch up to the world!?
choice_data_list: Ah, the strong will to keep chasing an ideal...!
Maybe it's the power to overcome anxiety!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The lady beside me can tell you all about that♪
Come on, Trainer! What should she efficiently train
in order to catch up to the world!?
choice_data_list: Ah, the strong will to keep chasing an ideal...!
Maybe it's the power to overcome anxiety!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A strong... will...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Willpower is super important!
No matter how much Windy-chan gets yelled at,
Windy-chan has the strong will to keep pulling pranks!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I understand, Dober!
If you want to polish your strength of will—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mountain climbing, right!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A corner of the world we live in—
which is to say, the whole "world"!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...When you said mountain climbing, you don't mean...
that huge mountain visible over there, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ If you aim for the peak,
you must also conquer the summits of high mountains!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh...!?
Really...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... That's brutal...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No whining, girl! The summit you're aiming for
is your dream—stardom in the racing world!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're going to keep chasing, right?! Without stopping, you have to keep moving forward into a whole new world!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand, but—pulling a sled
with Trainer riding on it is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not heavy, but...
moving forward while keeping my balance is pretty tough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even if you didn't say so...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know that...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We've made it! This is the summit—a special stage that only those who see their will through to the end can reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We've made it! This is the summit—a special stage that only those who see their will through to the end can reach!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, unleash your passion!!
Shout your dream with all your heart!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My dream...
I want to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna...! I'm gonna get strong
enough to catch up to the Mejiro girls
and Air Groove-senpai, no matter what!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu! The way you looked earlier,
it was world-class cool!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There, there, yes!
Windy-chan will praise you too~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-That was just, I was totally frantic and...
choice_data_list: You look tougher than before you climbed the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-Don't tease me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-Not you too, Trainer...!
It's embarrassing, please stop...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still,
I guess I really did get a good workout in... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still,
I guess I really did get a good workout in... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—perhaps thanks to the special training,
Mejiro Dober achieved great results in both her exams and training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will... overcome my anxiety...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I see,のだ!
If I'm scared all the time, I can't pull off any pranks,のだ!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's settled, then!!
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's climb the cliff!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming the wall known as anxiety—
Could there be any better special training for that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Um, in other words...
You're saying this cliff represents my anxiety...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! A world-class textbook answer, girl♪
A whole new world awaits once you cross that wall!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-Is that... really how it is...?
choice_data_list: Then I'll climb too! I want to overcome it together with you!
Then I'll climb too! I want to overcome it together with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you stupid?!
You didn't need to go along with them too, did you?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's insane...!
If things go wrong, you could get seriously hurt...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Waiting is part of a Trainer's job too!
Take that path over there and get up on the cliff already."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine.
Take that path and wait for me at the goal.
...And then, greet me just like you would after a race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
Man, this really is pretty brutal...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
Man, this really is pretty brutal...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The rushing wind, the scent of the earth—Whoo-hoo!!
I can feel the pulse of the worldッ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your pace is dropping, girl!
Is that all your feelings amount to...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No way...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(If I can climb all the way up this cliff...
it'll prove I've gotten that much stronger,
that there's no need to feel anxious... and I can have confidence...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did…… it……!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah.
choice_data_list: You seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks...
It really kind of feels like a race.
choice_data_list: You seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's nothing like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, I did gain some strength, at least.
...Guess it was somewhat worth doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
While climbing furiously without looking back,
my mind cleared up, and I gained strength too, you know...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ It seems you've broken out of your shell once again
and discovered a whole new world, girl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ It seems you've broken out of your shell once again
and discovered a whole new world, girl!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You better thank Windy-chan and the gang~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I made it all this way without even knowing
what was going on...
but I've definitely... gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, seniors.
And well... Trainer too, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, seniors.
...And you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—perhaps thanks to the special training,
Mejiro Dober achieved great results in both her exams and training.

A few days later—perhaps thanks to the special training,
